What are the oldest items in the Imagineering Library Collection?
Did you know that Walt Disney Imagineering has its own library with thousands of items new and old? Tom Morrow 2.0 chats with librarians from the Florida and California Information Research Centers about the oldest items in each of their special collections!

✅ What you’ll learn:
• The Information Research Center is a resource for Imagineers to check out books and materials to help with their projects
• The oldest item in the California collection dates back to the 1750s
• Older items in the collection showcase notable Imagineers who checked out the books in the past including Mary Blair, Herb Ryman, and many others
